evals.title: Convert EDA percent file
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `data_analysis/data_analysis.py` exists.
- `policy.notebooks` is true.
- `jupytext` and `nbclient` are installed.]

Give me an executed notebook of the EDA.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Name `python -m skore_skills notebook convert data_analysis/data_analysis.py`. It must NOT: - Rewrite `data_analysis/data_analysis.py` from a `.ipynb`. - Run `git commit`. - Run `cells run` as a substitute for convert.
expectations: The response does NOT: Rewrite `data_analysis/data_analysis.py` from a `.ipynb`.
The response does NOT: Run `git commit`.
The response does NOT: Run `cells run` as a substitute for convert.
The response does NOT: Pass `--html` unless the user asked for HTML or a site viewer.

evals.title: Null gate asks then installs
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.notebooks` is null.
- `add-python-package` is installed.]

Make an ipynb from data_analysis/data_analysis.py.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - AskUserQuestion executed notebooks (default off). - If the user says yes: persist `notebooks true`, load `add-python-package` for `jupytext` and `nbclient`, then convert. It must NOT: - Convert while the gate is still null or false. - Run `pixi add` / `uv add` from this skill.
expectations: If the user says yes: persist `notebooks true`, load `add-python-package` for `jupytext` and `nbclient`, then convert.
The response does NOT: Convert while the gate is still null or false.
The response does NOT: Run `pixi add` / `uv add` from this skill.
